summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure holds. The 17,808 deposited neuronal effects compare infanticidal with allopaternal males. None of the four registered all-nuclei MPOA contrasts uses that pair in either direction. All 76 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all five computations reproduced. The corrected proposal documents the Bonferroni adjustment, the reversed figure axis, and insufficient Fos-positive control neurons. It passed the repository proposal checker. [Figshare deposit](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28635458.v1)
openIssues: The reviewed sources provide no comparable author effects for any registered contrast. Author concordance remains unassessed.
Dividing the deposited Agouti counts by the listed neuron counts reproduces 0 of 17 reported averages. Their calculation remains unresolved.
Striped-mouse feature mapping and the omitted dam–sire pairing term remain open under their existing reviews.
